handler.snapshot_limit: The snapshot is the source as of ~10:08Z, i.e. the 30-field version. The 29-field replies of 09:58Z and 10:01Z came from an earlier edit of the same file that was never saved anywhere; that version is recoverable only as its captured output.
handler.origin: Hand-built for 2K17 in the live lane. Not copied from a 2K19 handler. It borrows two helpers from Granite's 2K19 matchmaking module (Ipv4Word and default relay port/id constants) to pack the relay address.

requirement_source: Which fields a reply must carry, and their allowed values, are REPORTED by the live lane as read from the 2K17 client's reply validator. This lane did not re-verify that reading. Field NAMES used in the handler source are the live lane's labels; only CORRELATION_ID and RESULT are confirmed here by CRC32(name) = id.
